info.title: MarketSphere Commerce API
info.description: INR amounts are integer paise. Pagination: page (1-based), limit (1..100). Responses use data and optional meta. Orders: PENDING_PAYMENT → PAID → PARTIALLY_FULFILLED → FULFILLED → DELIVERED; unpaid orders may become CANCELLED, EXPIRED, PAYMENT_FAILED. Returns: REQUESTED → RECEIVED → REFUNDED or REJECTED. Local payment, shipping and settlement are simulators. Stripe test adapter requires external verification.
